source_scope_statement: Requires detection of one cation and one anion in a given salt; describes systematic anion analysis, cation analysis, dry tests and Group-zero through Group-VI headings. No individual ion names are enumerated on these practical pages.
ion_roster_count: No named ions enumerated by RBSE on pp.123–126; one cation + one anion task scope
group_table_finding: Group headings 0–VI are given, but no group-to-ion membership list appears in the RBSE pages reviewed.
method_safety_limit: RBSE syllabus page is an outline, not a full reagent/method protocol; no unknown salt identity, reagent formulation, quantities, concentrations, compatibility or confirmatory matrix is stated.

source_scope_statement: Experiment 7.1 separately enumerates 14 cations and 12 anions and excludes insoluble salts. It is not an ion roster printed in the RBSE 2026–27 practical syllabus.
group_table_finding: Table 7.11 provides cation group memberships; Pb2+ appears in both Group-I and Group-II rows. The group table does not assign groups to anions.
method_safety_limit: Unit 7 includes acid reactions and gas-evolution tests (including H2S, SO2 and NO2 references); method text is documentary source evidence only, not a safety approval or executable workflow.
